name: Bánh căn
summary: Bánh căn is a stall name on the provincial night-market page, listed with bún chả and chả cá. The page does not say what is in it.
origin: Named at the Trần Phú night market in Nha Trang. A recipe was not printed.
howToEat: The night-market page names bánh căn and does not describe a method. Check on arrival.
where: The 137 m walking street behind 46 Trần Phú, Lộc Thọ. The page prints no stall number and no clock.
seoTitle: Bánh căn in Nha Trang — a night-market name
seoDescription: Bánh căn is named at the Trần Phú night market. The provincial page does not describe the cake, and no plate photo was found.
